scientific_integrity: The universal theorem follows from the written proof; independent finite brute force and exact constraint checks support small cases only. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to q>=3, exact Hamming distance equal to dimension, and forbidden clique orders 3<=t<=q; near-extremal stability and intermediate distances are not addressed. Historical priority and independent proof validation are outstanding.
title: Exact clique-free extrema and rigidity in tensor powers of complete graphs
